verdict.rationale: OpenCode's GitHub integration directly covers this story. Mentioning /opencode or /oc on an issue runs the agent in a GitHub Actions runner, where it works in a new branch and submits a PR with all the changes; setup of the app, workflow and secrets is guided. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the issue-to-PR flow, and documentation of how the generated PR is validated (tests/CI) and iterated on after review comments.

support.subject: As a developer, I can turn a tracked issue into a complete pull request end-to-end

citations.quote: Ask OpenCode to fix an issue or implement a feature. And it will work in a new branch and submits a PR with all the changes.
Mention /opencode or /oc in your comment, and OpenCode will execute tasks within your GitHub Actions runner.
This will walk you through installing the GitHub app, creating the workflow, and setting up secrets.
